# seleniumbase-rs

> A Rust port of Python SeleniumBase 4.58.3 and its MCP server: a `BaseCase` test API over WebDriver, a pure Chrome DevTools Protocol engine with no driver, undetected-Chrome patching and humanized input, a browser pool, request interception, and MCP servers that let AI agents drive, debug and write browser tests. Version 0.10.0 (not on crates.io); most behaviour is verified against a mock or unit tests rather than a real browser.

Start here if you are an AI agent working in the repository or using the crate.

## Working on the repository

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/AGENTS.md): commands, rules, boundaries.
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): the module map and gotchas.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): the checks and how to add things.
- [docs/guides/get-started/building.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/docs/guides/get-started/building.md): features, binaries, Docker.

## Using the crate

- [README.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/README.md): what it is and the project status.
- [docs/guides/get-started/getting-started.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/docs/guides/get-started/getting-started.md): a first test.
- [docs/guides/write-tests/best-practices.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/docs/guides/write-tests/best-practices.md): habits and rules for browser tests that do not flake, in terms of this crate's API (the rules are also in AGENTS.md).
- [docs/guides/browser-engines/pure-cdp.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/docs/guides/browser-engines/pure-cdp.md): the driver-free engine.
- [docs/ecosystem/mcp/server.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/docs/ecosystem/mcp/server.md): the MCP servers and their tools.
- [docs/ecosystem/mcp/vibe-coding.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/docs/ecosystem/mcp/vibe-coding.md): explore a page, export a test, read a failure.
- [docs/stealth/session/overview.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/docs/stealth/session/overview.md): where the layered stealth companion crate lives in https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs-stealth (`identity`, `client`, `network`, `session`, plus standalone `h3d/` for HTTP/3): unified fingerprints, 42-surface JS masking, 32 evasion providers, `StealthLayer`, `StealthPlan`, wire specs, `MitmProxy`, `CdpSession`, `HttpSession`, and `HybridSession`.
- [docs/guides/configure-runs/run-settings.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/docs/guides/configure-runs/run-settings.md): `RunSettings`, the run-wide knobs Python takes from pytest options (demo, slow, fast, demo sleep, message duration, skip JS waits, record sleep, visual baseline reset), and which `BaseCase` calls honour each (the pauses reach `open`, `click`, `type_text`, `update_text` and `press_keys` only).
- [docs/why-rust/reliability.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/docs/why-rust/reliability.md): waits, errors, cleanup.
- [docs/guides/help/common-problems.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/docs/guides/help/common-problems.md): troubleshooting.

- [docs/why-rust/parity.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/docs/why-rust/parity.md): the status of every upstream API (generated from `parity/api.toml`).
- [docs/api/api_reference.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/docs/api/api_reference.md): the `BaseCase` API.
